The '''Sunsworn Offensive''' is a faction of [[High elf|high elves]] of the [[Silvermoon Remnant]] that is loyal to Lord [[Astalor Sunsworn]] that formed following the removal of Lady [[Vereesa Windrunner]] as Speaker of the Remnant and the establishment of the [[Regency Council]]. They are primarily in opposition to the [[Silver Covenant]], a faction of the Remnant loyal to Lady Windrunner, with whom they clash in [[Sunstrider Court]] in what they call "friendly competition."<ref>[[Patch 1.18.0#NEW ARENA — SUNSTRIDER COURT]]</ref>
